projectData.title: Color Wheel Sorting
projectData.description: A unique visual representation of a variety of common sorting algorithms using a color wheel. Each slice in the circle represents a hue in the color spectrum, which are mapped to a digit between 0 and 359. These can then be shuffled and sorted to show how various sorting algorithms work in real time.

projectData.title: Mosaic Quilt
projectData.description: Implementation of various image processing algorithms from scratch. Includes basic pixel operations like brightness/contrast control, as well as convolution operations such as sharpening, blurring, edge detection, and dithering. Applies a quilt-like mosaic mask given a set of album and film covers.

projectData.title: DMV Auto Booker
projectData.description: A Selenium-based webscraper that automates the process of booking a DMV appointment for drivers license/state ID/learners permit renewals and road tests. These can take several months to book due to high demand, as openings are sparse and can be snagged within a few minutes of freeing up. The script checks various locations and searches intermitently until a valid appointment is found.
